summary: Frontend testing completed for 4 specific bug fixes in sports club management app. All 5 features tested and verified: Coach name SERZI LUCIO, WhatsApp button, dark blue training days, medical certificate not in documents list, print functionality.

1_coach_name_serzi_lucio.details: Coach name 'SERZI LUCIO' is correctly displayed in 'Coach della Squadra' section on athlete dashboard

2_whatsapp_button.details: 'Contatta su WhatsApp' button appears next to coach name with green icon

3_training_days_dark_blue.details: Training days (Lunedì through Venerdì) are displayed in dark blue color #1565C0 (rgb(21, 101, 192))

4_medical_certificate_not_in_docs_list.details: Medical certificate is NOT in the documents list - only shown as separate upload section at top of page

5_print_certificate_preview.details: handlePrintCertificate() function properly opens print preview window using window.open() for both images and PDFs. Could not test popup due to browser automation restrictions.

seed_data_creation: None - used existing athlete FERRI GENNY
